# Decisions

The decisions that shape the catalog in plain language, each linking its ADR. This list is generated from the pages of the folder; edit the pages, never this file.

- [The catalog data follows one set of modeling rules](The-catalog-data-follows-one-set-of-modeling-rules.md) (ADR-0003): Every record has a generated identity and change tracking, lists of values are code lists, money and text have fixed shapes (ADR-0003).
- [Code lists use stable upper-case codes](Code-lists-use-stable-upper-case-codes.md) (ADR-0010): The lists the catalog keeps itself identify each value by a short stable upper-case code, and the screen shows the name (ADR-0010).
- [Fixed lists of values are chosen from a dropdown showing names](Fixed-lists-of-values-are-chosen-from-a-dropdown-showing-names.md) (ADR-0011): A short stable list such as the categories appears as a dropdown with names, while long or growing lists keep a search dialog (ADR-0011).
- [Products are edited through drafts](Products-are-edited-through-drafts.md) (ADR-0012): A product is created and changed in a private draft that becomes the product only on Save, with the standard Edit, Save and Cancel buttons (ADR-0012).
- [The catalog is open to signed-in users with a viewer or editor role](The-catalog-is-open-to-signed-in-users-with-a-viewer-or-editor-role.md) (ADR-0013): Every request needs a signed-in user, a viewer only reads, an editor does everything, and the screen hides the buttons a viewer cannot use (ADR-0013).
- [A draft or locked product is marked in the list](A-draft-or-locked-product-is-marked-in-the-list.md) (ADR-0015): The product list marks a row that has a draft or is locked by another user, through the name column and without any custom code (ADR-0015).
- [A custom filter field replaces the standard field of its property](A-custom-filter-field-replaces-the-standard-field-of-its-property.md) (ADR-0020): When the standard filter field does not fit, such as a range slider for the rating, a small custom control takes its place and sets the filter (ADR-0020).
- [Products are imported from an Excel workbook](Products-are-imported-from-an-Excel-workbook.md) (ADR-0021): An editor uploads an .xlsx file from the product list; every row is checked like a normal product and either all rows are created or none (ADR-0021).
- [A dependent field offers only the values of its parent field](A-dependent-field-offers-only-the-values-of-its-parent-field.md) (ADR-0024): The subcategory list shows only the subcategories of the chosen category, a mismatch is refused, and a changed category clears a foreign subcategory (ADR-0024).
- [A field is disabled until the field it depends on is filled](A-field-is-disabled-until-the-field-it-depends-on-is-filled.md) (ADR-0025): A field that makes sense only after another field is filled stays disabled until then, and shows the required marker once it is enabled (ADR-0025).
- [Product details are rows of reusable attributes](Product-details-are-rows-of-reusable-attributes.md) (ADR-0026): A product holds detail rows, each pointing to an attribute that the product's subcategory offers, with at most one row per attribute (ADR-0026).
- [Product details are typed and shown as a generated form](Product-details-are-typed-and-shown-as-a-generated-form.md) (ADR-0027): Each attribute has a value type, the draft creates one empty row per attribute of the subcategory, and one generic form shows them (ADR-0027).
- [Validation rules follow one toolkit and prevent before they refuse](Validation-rules-follow-one-toolkit-and-prevent-before-they-refuse.md) (ADR-0028): The validation rules of issue 10 use declarative constraints with custom texts, two-field messages and a control that prevents the error first, and three proposed rules were not taken (ADR-0028).
- [Documentation descriptions live in doc comments and the API document is generated](Documentation-descriptions-live-in-doc-comments-and-the-API-document-is-generated.md) (ADR-0029): One kind of doc comment describes every artefact, and the OpenAPI document, the code reference page and the JSDoc lint gate are generated or checked from it (ADR-0029).
- [Pipeline decisions](Pipeline-decisions.md) (16 ADRs): The decisions about the tooling, the agents and the documentation that build the catalog, each listed by title with a link to its ADR.
